messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
The party seeks pre war techs
Enter company tower
The rooms are dim
Ash fills the air
Old ash coats the walls
The party finds the vault
The vault has gates
Two deactivated replica android units lie in the rooms
The duo is off
Machine codes act as CEO
Machine minds own old rules
Duo alone can key the stash
The stash holds pre war techs
The stash rests under the floor
The pre war techs sleep
Red lamps hum low
Beacons hum in the rooms
Old bots guard the ways
Traps sit in the walls
Steel doors bar the ways
Power cells are off
The party can add power
Add cells to the cores
Start the duo
The duo wakes
Faces light up
Two tones hum
The duo ask for proof
The duo wants service
The duo wants the company alive
Serve the company
Prove old oaths
Share codes to prove loyalty
The gates yield
One dim space opens
In it lie pre war techs
Tools and drugs and steel
Chips and cores and disks
Rations and water
Pre war plans
Pre war codes
Way one start the duo
Way two trade goods
Way three fight bots
Way all run
If the duo fails
The stash stays still
The duo rests forever
